steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to this Odoo login page with email/login 'admin' and password exactly the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it literally as that placeholder text, it will be filled in when typed). Submit the login form and wait until you are logged in (the Odoo apps/home page or sales app appears). Report what page you end up on and the logged-in user name shown.

02-create: Create a new customer contact in this Odoo 17 backend named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Use the Contacts app (or Sales app's Customers menu) — open the create form, fill Name and City (City is under the Address section; you may need to add the address fields), save it. Then verify by reopening the record and report the Name and City values you see on the saved record. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

03-create: In this Odoo 17 backend, create a new Quotation in the Sales app for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (the customer field is an autocomplete dropdown — you must actually select the matching option from the dropdown, not just type the name). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (again the product field is an autocomplete dropdown — select an actual option from the dropdown), with quantity 3. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app filled in on that line, (c) the untaxed amount the app computed (Untaxed Amount in the totals section), and (d) the quotation's name/reference shown in the breadcrumb or title bar. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

A later step of this flow uses these values, so before you report, read each one from the page with `read` (label=<name>) and report it under exactly this name: quotation_reference.

04-open: Open the existing quotation {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (reference {{03-create.quotation_reference}}, for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer') in this Odoo 17 Sales app — you can navigate to Sales > Orders > Quotations and search for {{03-create.quotation_reference}}, or open {{03-create.url}} . Add a SECOND order line: a product DIFFERENT from 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' (the product field is an autocomplete dropdown — select an actual option from the dropdown), with quantity 2. Save. Then report: (a) the product name of the new second line, (b) its unit price, (c) the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals section, and (d) both order lines' product names and quantities as shown on the saved form. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

05-open: Open the quotation {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (sale.order id {{03-create.url.q.id}}, URL {{03-create.url}}) in this Odoo 17 Sales app and report the EXACT current state of the order lines table and totals: list every order line row with its product name, quantity, unit price and subtotal, and read the 'Untaxed Amount', 'Taxes' and 'Total' values from the totals section. If there is any stray or empty order line (e.g. a line with product 'Customizable Desk' or a blank product), delete/remove that line and save, then report the final state. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state. Report the final list of lines and the final Untaxed Amount you actually see on screen.

06-open: Open the quotation {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (sale.order id {{03-create.url.q.id}}, URL {{03-create.url}}) in this Odoo 17 Sales app. Change the FIRST order line's quantity (the line for product '{{03-create.product_name}}') from 3 to 5 — leave the second line ('{{04-open.line2_product}}', qty 2) unchanged. Save the quotation. Then report from the saved form: (a) the first line's quantity and subtotal, (b) the second line's quantity and subtotal, and (c) the Untaxed Amount shown in the totals section. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

07-open: Open the quotation {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (sale.order id {{03-create.url.q.id}}, URL {{03-create.url}}) in this Odoo 17 Sales app and CONFIRM it: click the 'Confirm' button (or 'Confirm Sale' / 'Confirm Order') so the quotation becomes a sales order. If a confirmation dialog or wizard appears, accept it. Then report: (a) the order reference/name shown in the breadcrumb or title (e.g. {{03-create.quotation_reference}}), and (b) the status the app now shows in the status bar (e.g. 'Sales Order' / 'Sales'), and (c) whether the Confirm button is gone or replaced. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

08-open: Open the sales order {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (sale.order id {{03-create.url.q.id}}, URL {{03-create.url}}) in this Odoo 17 Sales app and CANCEL it: click the '{{07-open.statusbar_button_cancel}}' button (in the status bar buttons area, next to {{07-open.statusbar_button_create_invoice}} / {{07-open.statusbar_button_send_by_email}} / {{07-open.statusbar_button_preview}}). If a confirmation dialog appears asking to confirm the cancellation, accept it. Then report: (a) the order reference shown in the breadcrumb/title, and (b) the status the app now shows in the status bar (e.g. 'Cancelled'), and (c) whether the {{07-open.statusbar_button_cancel}} button is gone. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.
